area: Silver Saddle Ranch & Club, California City
disposition: second alarm; three buildings fully involved; extensive mop-up
summary: Firefighters were sent to the old two-story hotel resort in California City early Thursday for a large commercial structure on fire, and the call went to a second alarm almost immediately. Crews found three buildings fully involved with an exposure to the east and four spot fires in vegetation to the south backing into the wind. The only hydrant on scene was dead, so a water tender and support from Edwards were brought in. Firefighters kept the flames out of the main exposure while a smaller building became the priority, and about an acre to an acre and a half of grass and brush burned around the complex. The initial fire buildings were reported 100 percent involved, and crews settled in for an extensive mop-up as winds turned erratic on one side of the fire.

disposition: trailer fully involved; lanes blocked; traffic diverted to Highway 99; no injuries
summary: A semi caught fire on Interstate 5 near Copus Road, south of the Grapevine, with the trailer still attached. Crews reported the fire near the wheel wells and then the whole trailer engulfed in heavy smoke. The burning rig blocked lanes and units routed traffic off the freeway onto Highway 99 while heavy towing was called in. One lane was expected to reopen within about ten minutes, and the ambulance was cancelled with no one hurt.

area: the 7000 block of Di Giorgio Road
disposition: forced entry reported; search under way
summary: A hysterical caller reported that three people, two men and one woman, forced their way in through the front door of an apartment in the 7000 block of Di Giorgio Road in south Bakersfield. Officers were sent to search the unit and the surrounding area, and medics staged nearby.

area: North Edwards area, east Kern County
disposition: suspect reported in the roadway with a long gun
summary: Deputies were sent to the North Edwards area for a man in a black shirt and gray sweatpants standing in the middle of a roadway with a large firearm, possibly a rifle or shotgun. The caller, who was picking up juveniles from a school event, said the man was letting the juveniles cross the street before she left with them and filed a report.

disposition: vehicle fled the area; suspect not located
summary: A caller reported a man in an orange Chevrolet pickup dragging a woman from a residence on Pacific Street, with the woman heard yelling as she was put into the truck and the vehicle left the area. Officers checked the neighborhood and tried to find the truck by its plate and through the license plate readers, but the suspect and the woman were not immediately located.

disposition: domestic call; firearms reported inside the home
summary: Deputies were sent to the 11000 block of Kyte Avenue for a disturbance that escalated into a report of an elderly man striking a 12-year-old with a broom. The caller told dispatchers there were firearms inside the residence. No injuries were confirmed.

area: Pacheco Road and South Union Avenue
disposition: patient reported down in the roadway
summary: Medics were sent to Pacheco Road and South Union Avenue for a person reported to have possibly been hit by a vehicle and down on the roadway. Officers were already at the intersection, which had drawn traffic on both streets.

area: the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue
disposition: business window reported broken; suspect described
summary: Officers were sent to a business in the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue for a possible burglary just reported. A caller described a man carrying a broken piece of metal who said he was running from someone trying to hurt him. A white sedan was seen pulling up in front of the store.

disposition: suspect known to the victim; not located
summary: A woman on Hillcrest Drive reported that her adult son shoved her against a wall and threw her into it. She told dispatchers he was known to carry a pocket knife, though none had been seen that day. Deputies responded from the surrounding area and a second report of a battery victim flagged down deputies nearby.

disposition: suspect fled on a bicycle; firearm reported inside
summary: Deputies were sent to a domestic violence call after a woman reported her ex-boyfriend jumped a fence and forced his way in through the front door and a window. A friend inside the home was reported to have a handgun. The suspect left on a bicycle in an unknown direction and was described as wearing dark clothing and a black baseball cap.
Medics were sent to the 6800 block of Foothill Drive for an ill patient.

disposition: subject no longer in the area
summary: A caller reported that a woman fell out of a vehicle, but she was no longer in the area when officers checked.
Officers were asked to respond to the 1200 block of 40th Street for four juveniles around 14 and 15 years old smoking on the property.
Officers were sent to the 7-Eleven on Lake Street to keep the peace over a property dispute.
A woman with a hammer was reported at the 2100 block of Oildale Drive after she broke a business window. She was not reported to have hurt anyone.
A 911 hang-up call came in from the 10400 block of Elm Cove, and dispatchers were working to call the number back.

area: northbound Interstate 5 at the Frazier Mountain Park Road off-ramp
disposition: semi disabled at the end of the ramp
summary: A semi was reported stopped at the end of the northbound Interstate 5 off-ramp at Frazier Mountain Park Road.

area: Chester Avenue and West Columbus Street
summary: Fire crews were sent south of the river off Chester Avenue and West Columbus Street for a single report at a house, with a patrol and a battalion responding.
Crews cleared a call for a woman attacked by a dog, which was completed as an ambulance-only response.
A domestic disturbance was reported in the 2900 block of Catalina Drive after a woman's boyfriend left. The caller was still on the move, walking to a relative's house.
A medical alarm activation came in from a senior living community on Westwood Drive for a person requesting assistance, possibly after a fall.
A company was sent to a roughly half-acre grass fire in the county and called it the morning incident, with crews on scene holding the spread.
Medics were sent to a business in the 2700 block of White Lane for a patient in respiratory distress.
A crew handled a public service call in the 8600 block of Lighthouse Drive.
Deputies were sent to the 4400 block of White Lane for a repeat domestic disturbance after a woman was reported trying to get into an apartment door.
A disturbance was reported in the 3600 block of Pacer Street, where four or five people were possibly drinking and playing loud music in the street.
A caller reported a partially undressed man standing at a front door in the 2200 block of Commercial Avenue with a laptop, after earlier hearing the screen door rattle.

disposition: nothing found; no gunshots heard by nearby units
summary: A report of possible gunshots was checked in the county, but units that were nearby at the time said they heard nothing and no one was found.

area: the 3100 block of Sierra Highway, Rosamond
summary: An overdose call drew an ambulance from Mojave to a senior center in the 3100 block of Sierra Highway in the Rosamond area.
A caller reported a man lying motionless on the ground and got no response when he honked his horn. Medics and deputies responded for an unknown medical aid.
